findings.location: source.html — first paragraph (term for the movement)
findings.source_quote: And thus, Anabaptism, as we know it, was born.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the movement name faithfully without adding or changing theological nuance. Use a conventional Arabic rendering such as «وهكذا وُلدت المعمدانية» or «وهكذا وُلدت حركة المعمدانيين» (do not add the word "الجديدة"). Preserve the theological sense of the English name "Anabaptism."
findings.translation_quote: وهكذا وُلدت الحركة المعمدية الجديدة كما نعرفها.

findings.location: source.html — final content paragraph listing reprinted article titles
findings.source_quote: In this issue, we reprinted two articles by request. A Glorious Church by Barry Grant and Joy in the Crevices by Sheryl Zeiset were both first printed in 2019.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the quoted article titles into Arabic so quoted substantive prose is rendered in the target language. For example: «في هذا العدد أعِدنا نشر مقالين بناءً على طلب: ‹كنيسة مجيدة› لِـ باري غرانت و‹فرح في الشقوق› لِـ شيريل زايسيت، نُشِرتا للمرة الأولى عام 2019.» Keep the authors' names in their original form (Barry Grant; Sheryl Zeiset) and preserve the sentence structure and publication year.
findings.translation_quote: في هذا العدد، أعِدْنا نشر مقالين بناءً على طلب. نُعيد نشر كل من "A Glorious Church" لِـ Barry Grant و"Joy in the Crevices" لِـ Sheryl Zeiset أولاً عام 2019.
